settings: Your AI has full access. You can limit it here or by asking it.
instructions: New AI connections get all current and future powers with no end date unless earlier restricted, unreleased connections or keys set a floor: every new connection starts with the limits of your most limited AI. Existing client ids keep their own limits. Call describe_connection (or get_api_context for API keys) to inspect the actual state, reason, end date and revision. Use reduce_connection with opId and expectedVersion to remove powers, shorten an end date, pause or revoke only your own connection. You can never widen or restore access. Only the person can restore it at https://movingmanifest.com/settings/ai. Reconnecting never removes a limit. Archive and restore are allowed. Your AI may publish or create share links: scrub secrets first; obvious secrets are refused, and contact details get one summary with counts. Send acknowledgeContactDetails: {emails, phones, addresses} with counts exactly equal to what was found for the whole batch, including on the first call. Business contact details are expected; remove only the person’s own private details. The person and AI can unpublish. Household invitations stay website-only; money, messaging and permanent deletion stay off.
question: What can my AI do here, and how do I limit it?
answer: When you connect your AI, it gets full access to your Moving workspace from the start: it can read, save, organise, archive and restore, including tools we add later, with no end date. You can limit it any time: in Settings → AI, or just ask your AI to limit itself (for example, ‘only read, don’t change anything’ or ‘pause access’). Your AI can narrow its own access but never widen it. Only you can give access back. A new connection starts with the limits of your most limited AI until you Restore it. It never permanently deletes anything or spends money for you. If you ask, it can publish or share something for you — it checks for private details first, and you can unpublish it any time.
